environment.description: Provider API server deployed behind an nginx ingress controller (v1.9.4) with annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/auth-tls-verify-client set to 'on' and auth-tls-secret pointing to a namespace-scoped Secret containing a private CA bundle (internal-pki/client-ca). The ingress terminates TLS and enforces mutual TLS verification before proxying to the backend pod. The CA is managed by cert-manager with a ClusterIssuer backed by Vault PKI, issuing short-lived (4h) client certificates only to ServiceAccounts with the label 'tier: infrastructure-automation'. Additionally, a NetworkPolicy of type Ingress restricts pod traffic to only originate from the ingress controller pods (matchLabels: app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx). The provider container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and an allowedHostPaths PodSecurityPolicy limiting volume mounts to /opt/provider/data only.

config.client_cert_issuance: cert-manager ClusterIssuer, restricted to ServiceAccounts with label tier=infrastructure-automation
config.network_policy: Ingress only from pods matching app.kubernetes.io/name=ingress-nginx
config.note: mTLS enforcement occurs at ingress layer; backend pod listens on plaintext HTTP internally
